title: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde

scenes.visual_description: A quiet by-street in a busy quarter of Victorian London on a Sunday morning. On one side, cheerful shop fronts with polished brass and fresh paint line the way. Breaking this pattern on the left is a sinister, windowless two-story building with a blistered, discolored door and neglected masonry. The street is relatively empty, with a sharp contrast between the bright shops and the dark, sordid entry.

A sombre Victorian business room lit by a single candle. A heavy iron safe stands open in the corner. A mahogany desk is cluttered with legal papers and a reading stand holding a divinity book. The atmosphere is austere, shadowy, and strictly professional, with dark wood panelling and muted rug tones.

scenes.location_header: INT. DR. LANYON'S DINING ROOM - NIGHT
scenes.visual_description: A warm, well-lit Victorian dining room. A table is set with decanters of wine and crystal glasses catching the gaslight. The room is comfortable and theatrical, with red velvet curtains and polished furniture, reflecting the hearty nature of its owner. The mood is convivial but professional.

A darkened Victorian bedchamber in the small hours of the morning. A large four-poster bed with heavy curtains dominates the room. Shadows from streetlamps filter through the window, creating shifting patterns on the walls. The atmosphere is oppressive, restless, and haunted.

A large, low-roofed hall paved with flagstones, resembling a country house. A bright open fire casts flickering light on costly oak cabinets and polished surfaces. The room is warm and wealthy, but shadows dance uneasily on the ceiling. The mood is comfortable yet tinged with unease.

segments.title: DR. JEKYLL WAS QUITE AT EASE

scenes.visual_description: A large, comfortable Victorian hall resembling a country house, paved with flagstones and warmed by a bright open fire. Costly oak cabinets and polished furniture catch the flickering warm light. Shadows dance on the low roof. The atmosphere is wealthy, pleasant, and intimate, with a hearthside setting.

A narrow Victorian lane in London bathed in brilliant full moonlight. The scene is quiet and high-contrast, with sharp shadows cast by the surrounding garden walls and townhouses. The atmosphere is initially peaceful and romantic, turning stark. The cobblestones gleam under the moon.

A stark Victorian police station interior. The walls are whitewashed brick or painted a dull institutional colour. A wooden desk and bench sit under the light of a gas lamp and a high, barred window letting in grey morning light. The atmosphere is grim, official, and cold.

A dingy Soho street submerged in thick, chocolate-coloured fog. Gas lamps flicker weakly against the swirling brown gloom. Muddy cobblestones are visible in the foreground. To the side, the blistered door of a neglected house stands out against the dark, nightmarish atmosphere of the quarter.

A luxuriously furnished Victorian room in a state of chaos. Elegant furniture, silver plate, and a fine painting contrast with clothes scattered on the floor and drawers pulled open. A fireplace in the foreground holds a pile of grey ashes. The mood is tense and violated.

scenes.location_header: INT. DR. JEKYLL'S CABINET - LATE AFTERNOON
scenes.visual_description: A dingy, windowless Victorian laboratory cabinet. The room is large and gaunt, fitted with glass presses and chemical apparatus. A fire burns in the grate, casting dim light. Three dusty windows barred with iron look out onto a foggy courtyard. The atmosphere is secluded, scientific, and deathly still.

A sombre Victorian business room lit by a single candle. A heavy iron safe stands open in the corner. A mahogany desk is cluttered with legal papers and a reading stand holding a divinity book. The atmosphere is austere, shadowy, and strictly professional, with dark wood panelling and muted rug tones.

scenes.location_header: INT. DR. LANYON'S DINING ROOM - NIGHT
scenes.visual_description: A warm, well-lit Victorian dining room. A table is set with decanters of wine and crystal glasses catching the gaslight. The room is comfortable and theatrical, with red velvet curtains and polished furniture, reflecting the hearty nature of its owner. The mood is convivial but professional.

A damp, enclosed courtyard in Victorian London, bathed in premature twilight while the sky above remains bright. Three windows of a sombre building overlook the yard; the middle one is half-open. The atmosphere is cool, gloomy, and confined, with shadows gathering in the corners of the paved court. High walls block the view of the street, creating a sense of isolation.

A sombre Victorian business room lit by the warm glow of a fireside and a single candle. A heavy iron safe stands open in the corner. A mahogany desk is cluttered with legal papers. The atmosphere is austere, shadowy, and strictly professional, with dark wood panelling and muted rug tones.

A large, comfortable Victorian hall paved with flagstones and warmed by a bright open fire. Costly oak cabinets and polished furniture catch the flickering warm light, contrasting with the dark wind-swept street outside. Shadows dance on the low roof. The atmosphere is tense, with a group of servants huddled near the hearth.

A cavernous Victorian kitchen with a high ceiling, currently cold and dark. A large distinct fireplace stands empty and black. Shadows stretch across the flagstone floor where beetles scuttle. A single candle illuminates a rough wooden table. The atmosphere is neglected, eerie, and silent.

A gloomy anatomical theatre, cluttered with crates, straw, and bottles. The space is vast and shadowy, lit only by a moving candle. Steep rising tiers of benches are barely visible in the darkness. A red baize door stands at the top of a short flight of stairs. Dust and cobwebs cover the lumber.

A large Victorian cabinet room, strangely quiet and domestic. A good fire glows in the grate, with a kettle singing. A business table is neatly arranged with papers and tea things. Glazed presses full of chemicals line the walls. A cheval-glass mirror reflects the room. The atmosphere is incongruously peaceful despite the tragedy.

A Victorian medical consulting room at midnight. A heavy mahogany desk sits under the harsh light of a reading lamp, surrounded by glass cabinets filled with instruments and medical texts. Dark leather chairs and anatomical charts create a sterile, scientific atmosphere. The room is shadowed, with bright light focused on the desk where a drawer sits.
